import base64, hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-curated-tools')
repo_bytes = (root / 'raw/repository.json').read_bytes()
readme_bytes = (root / 'raw/readme.json').read_bytes()
repo = json.loads(repo_bytes)
readme = json.loads(readme_bytes)
assert readme['encoding'] == 'base64'
lines = base64.b64decode(readme['content']).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
pattern = re.compile(r'contribut|pull request|submit|self.promot|affiliat|diagnos|debug|playground|browser|online|lint|download|example|generated|AI\b', re.I)
selected = {n for i, line in enumerate(lines) if pattern.search(line) for n in range(max(0, i-1), min(len(lines), i+2))}
result = {'repository_capture_sha256': hashlib.sha256(repo_bytes).hexdigest(), 'readme_capture_sha256': hashlib.sha256(readme_bytes).hexdigest(), 'repository_metadata': {k: repo.get(k) for k in ('html_url', 'archived', 'disabled', 'pushed_at', 'default_branch')}, 'readme_url': readme.get('html_url'), 'readme_line_count': len(lines), 'excerpts': [{'line': n+1, 'text': lines[n]} for n in sorted(selected)[:100]], 'excerpt_limit_reached': len(selected) > 100, 'limit': 'Keyword excerpts are pointers. Inspect the complete README and any linked contribution policy before drawing conclusions.'}
output = root / 'director-placement-source-screen.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'excerpt_count': len(result['excerpts']), 'readme_line_count': len(lines)}))
